a2b374fddf2f0492141da0f237e94a0c0ba11325.text: Infrastructure teams describe cloud and on-premises resources in reusable configuration files. OpenTofu uses provider APIs to manage components such as servers, networks, storage and DNS. Its workflow separates writing configuration, reviewing a plan and applying the approved changes. State records track managed resources, while modules package configurations for reuse.
a2b374fddf2f0492141da0f237e94a0c0ba11325.review_note: Checked against the linked official source; paraphrased for the specimen sheet. Proposed for inclusion in this PR.

features.title: Preview the changes
features.text: Review an execution plan before applying resource changes. OpenTofu orders approved operations around their dependencies.

features.title: Reusable infrastructure
features.text: Modules package configurable infrastructure so teams can reuse configurations across projects.

88684ee6223e89613d45d7d8acfe54b2a4e69968.text: OpenRefine works on messy datasets locally, using facets to isolate records and clustering to consolidate inconsistent values. Reconciliation services connect records to external databases, and transformations can change formats or enrich data from web services. The operation history supports undo, redo and replay on another version of a dataset.
88684ee6223e89613d45d7d8acfe54b2a4e69968.review_note: Checked against the linked official source; paraphrased for the specimen sheet. Proposed for inclusion in this PR.

features.title: Replay a cleanup
features.text: Undo or redo changes, then replay the operation history on another version of the dataset.

features.title: Find inconsistent values
features.text: Clustering groups similar values so spelling and formatting inconsistencies can be consolidated.

13f08bab005ffd3059f206ffa72c6e33c964e3c7.text: Create solid models by writing scripts that describe geometry and configurable parameters. OpenSCAD renders those definitions into models using constructive solid geometry and extrusion of two-dimensional outlines. It suits repeatable CAD work such as machine parts and parameterized designs, and runs on Linux, Windows and macOS. Supported exchange formats include STL, OFF and DXF.
13f08bab005ffd3059f206ffa72c6e33c964e3c7.review_note: Checked against the linked official source; paraphrased for the specimen sheet. Proposed for inclusion in this PR.

0855586218f0afd50d40c4539b143d71a24ffd7f.text: Connect numerical models to data-assimilation and parameter-calibration methods through a shared interface. OpenDA provides ensemble Kalman filters, a particle filter, 3DVar and optimization methods including Simplex, Powell and conjugate gradient. Researchers can compare compatible methods with their models and expose new methods through the same interface, with language interfaces for Java, C/C++ and Fortran.
0855586218f0afd50d40c4539b143d71a24ffd7f.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

08a8cb2d81e67d5842182f7182754765a7b93f79.text: Monitor websites, APIs and servers, publish status pages and coordinate incidents from a dashboard or Slack. Teams can declare monitors, status pages and notification channels in YAML or Terraform, then apply them through the command line or CI. The platform offers managed and self-hosted deployment, plus an API and MCP tools for operating these resources.
08a8cb2d81e67d5842182f7182754765a7b93f79.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

08ea82433025b65a15f5ad520e2383a375efa680.text: Explore a reimplementation of the SAGE real-time strategy engine focused on Command & Conquer: Generals and Zero Hour. OpenSAGE parses game data formats and renders animated 3D models from W3D files. The documented roadmap leaves gameplay systems unfinished; original game assets are not included, and the project uses data from an existing game installation.
08ea82433025b65a15f5ad520e2383a375efa680.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

09716987532046aef8869b7e10b2b7253ac42f4c.text: Turn a premise or supplied script into a planned sequence of shots, generated clips and an assembled video with subtitles. OpenCineAgent coordinates character portraits, keyframes, video generation, dialogue checks, retries, audio mixing and editing through a local Python pipeline. It uses ComfyUI models on an NVIDIA GPU, with human portrait approval and optional Ollama-assisted scriptwriting.
09716987532046aef8869b7e10b2b7253ac42f4c.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

097bec88e11b8196dae0f714b5bcb12ba8d8b540.text: Use a chat application hosted on the Internet Computer, with direct messages, groups and community channels. OpenChat supports bots that participate in conversations and moderation through its bot platform. Developers can run a local instance using DFX canisters and the web frontend, with repository scripts for deploying and upgrading the local canisters.
097bec88e11b8196dae0f714b5bcb12ba8d8b540.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

0092b9bbc696273433ce71d5772f97bd63b6f23e.text: Browse a curated software directory by category, platform, self-hosting support and other filters, or search for an application and the tools it replaces. OpenStore includes community project submissions, votes and requests for alternatives alongside editor-managed listings. It runs as a Next.js application; account features use GitHub OAuth and a persistent SQLite database.
0092b9bbc696273433ce71d5772f97bd63b6f23e.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

c02bf0d1fea4bf7fda6b7c35472c333590aff2bc.text: Build dashboards from named SQL queries and React panel definitions stored as ordinary files. open-dashboard renders charts against configured databases, keeps filters in shareable URLs and reloads the viewer when files change. Its local development server, command-line checks and optional MCP server support an authoring workflow in which a coding agent writes and validates dashboard definitions.
c02bf0d1fea4bf7fda6b7c35472c333590aff2bc.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

1f47a63aaef059c34f053c73f066bce5f50dbad3.text: Talk with an animated 3D character in a browser, with speech delivered over WebRTC and a separate model selecting expressions and gestures from the conversation transcript. open-annie derives mouth animation from audio and also includes scripted preview and recorded replay modes. Live conversations use a Python broker, run locally or on fal, plus external model-service credentials.
1f47a63aaef059c34f053c73f066bce5f50dbad3.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

10d69f0daa625d430823f0f96fe4a54501756699.text: Author paginated documents as React components, with generated outlines, contents lists, page numbers, footnotes and cross-references. open-doc provides a browser viewer, source-backed text editing, Markdown import and command-line layout checks. A local development server can expose MCP tools for authoring and review, while the export workflow produces PDF, HTML, DOCX or page images.
10d69f0daa625d430823f0f96fe4a54501756699.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

b44206282c760da32059c6a76cee1d8f36ed5901.text: Explore a simulated Brazilian election count through interactive state, municipality and electoral-zone maps, a scoreboard and a time slider. open-apuracao-brazil generates deterministic mock results in the browser and can export map images or share views through URLs. It builds as a static website; its results are fictional and do not come from an election-results service.
b44206282c760da32059c6a76cee1d8f36ed5901.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

f952835452592537ac04c71a848c03e1758cd346.text: OpenH264 is a video codec library for encoding and decoding H.264 streams, including use in real-time communication applications such as WebRTC. Its encoder supports rate control, temporal scalability, multiple output resolutions, and dynamic changes to bitrate, frame rate, and resolution. The repository also provides command-line encoding and decoding programs.
f952835452592537ac04c71a848c03e1758cd346.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

1cf5521e4f3d971b3cea3d28248f7a30e637e466.text: OpenLLaMA provides pretrained language models that reproduce the LLaMA architecture using different training datasets. The project distributes 3B, 7B, and 13B parameter model families with weights for PyTorch through Hugging Face Transformers and for JAX through EasyLM. Its documentation includes loading examples, training-data details, and evaluation comparisons for the released models.
1cf5521e4f3d971b3cea3d28248f7a30e637e466.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

3e6ed417a41919a48f262b9481f0b9196c860281.text: OpenRecall records a searchable history of desktop activity by taking screenshots at intervals and processing their contents locally. Users can search captured information or scroll through earlier snapshots to revisit what was on screen. The application supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, with controls for storage location and whether to capture only the primary monitor.
3e6ed417a41919a48f262b9481f0b9196c860281.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

c413b557fa79ae25b81f3f438f61e47362e8a006.text: Open Streaming Platform provides a self-hosted service for broadcasting RTMP video through Nginx-RTMP. Users can run multiple channels, record live streams, upload videos, and offer on-demand playback or shorter clips. Channel chat, moderation controls, restricted audiences, adaptive streaming, embeds, and webhooks support operating a small video-streaming community or service.
c413b557fa79ae25b81f3f438f61e47362e8a006.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

484814187d43f2b6a32f0bebfda32af1c3fcb1fd.text: Create specialized compressors from descriptions of structured data formats. OpenZL supplies a core library and tools that generate compressors compatible with a single universal decompressor. Developers can integrate these components into processing pipelines for specialized datasets, using the documented C and C++ build workflow and accompanying compression tools.
484814187d43f2b6a32f0bebfda32af1c3fcb1fd.review_note: Every capability checked against the official README at the cited commit. Paraphrased for the Function field; no candidate software executed.

5302907b521d495fcd4df1b42cbe473d37d7a22c.text: OpenDSS models electric utility distribution systems for planning and analysis, including distributed generation interconnections and time-varying loads. Its solution modes cover snapshot, daily and yearly power flow, harmonics, dynamics and fault studies. Users can operate a standalone executable through text scripts or drive the simulation engine from other applications through Windows COM and shared-library interfaces.
5302907b521d495fcd4df1b42cbe473d37d7a22c.review_note: Official EPRI introduction establishes intended studies, solution modes, standalone scripting, Windows COM and shared-library interfaces. No correctness or operational-safety claims.

24af095b5c53b4af51066f8a783a935e876f6931.text: Open Hexagon is an arcade survival game controlled by clockwise or counterclockwise rotation, a 180-degree position swap and a focus action that slows movement. Levels can introduce curving or accelerating walls and other scripted mechanics. Players can create custom levels with Lua, while online leaderboards provide a way to compare survival results.
24af095b5c53b4af51066f8a783a935e876f6931.review_note: Creator page establishes controls, survival mechanics and Lua customization; pinned README and developer-published Steam page establish leaderboards, with Steam specifying focus behavior. No free-to-play or performance claim.

1e59457b7413d807112e3f60186dcbea54275212.text: OpenJUMP is a Java geographic information system for viewing and editing map geometry and associated attributes. It reads and writes shapefiles and simple GML, accesses spatial databases, and supports imagery and WFS/WMS services. Users can run topology and overlay analyses, transform coordinate reference systems, style map layers and export a map view as SVG.
1e59457b7413d807112e3f60186dcbea54275212.review_note: Official capability section supports vector formats, spatial databases, images/services, geometry and attribute editing, analysis, coordinate transforms, styling and SVG export.

9d3cecd04f72828633cd1da0d0f24e0cb87bf69a.text: Open Library is a web application for maintaining an editable book catalog, with book and author discovery and reader-curated lists. Developers can query catalog data through public APIs or obtain monthly data dumps for bulk use. The Python application also has a documented Docker-based local development setup for contributors working on catalog features and integrations.
9d3cecd04f72828633cd1da0d0f24e0cb87bf69a.review_note: Pinned README confirms editable catalog. Developer Center confirms discovery, lists, Python, APIs and monthly dumps. Quick Start confirms local Docker development, not a hosted-service deployment guarantee.

c3cdcfdd208b07c7bb4c5b1d7f3c1e931d7979c6.text: OpenNumismat is a desktop application for recording coin collections with descriptions and photographs, alongside wish lists, selling lists and collection statistics. Its collection records can include acquisition details, condition, storage location and other catalog fields. The application stores collection data in SQLite and provides builds for Windows, Linux and macOS; its scope also includes other collectibles.
c3cdcfdd208b07c7bb4c5b1d7f3c1e931d7979c6.review_note: Desktop-only scope: homepage establishes lists/statistics; manual establishes photos, field types and SQLite; pinned README establishes builds and other collectibles. No Web-edition behavior included.

940b9064d9702a4687a341521a07789d1c7f8d7c.text: OpenRoads Designer is roadway design software for producing terrain models, road geometry, corridors and construction documentation. It combines survey-data workflows with drainage and utility modeling, cross sections and earthwork calculations. Designers can generate plans, profiles and cross-section sheets from a design model while keeping the 2D documentation and 3D geometry synchronized.

sources.title: OpenRoads Designer | Roadway Design Software | Bentley Systems

940b9064d9702a4687a341521a07789d1c7f8d7c.review_note: Bentley product and technical-capabilities sections establish terrain, geometry, survey, drainage/utilities, corridors, earthworks and synchronized deliverables. No accuracy, scale, price or licensing interpretation added.

91874098c295acfc1b15893d4fb08408cc17d912.text: OpenRocket lets model-rocket builders assemble designs from components, inspect them in 3D and simulate flight before construction. It supports staged rockets and motor clusters, six-degree-of-freedom simulation, design optimization and plots of flight results. This Java-based application can export designs to RockSim or RASAero II and component geometry to OBJ or SVG for fabrication workflows.
91874098c295acfc1b15893d4fb08408cc17d912.review_note: Pinned README establishes component design, 3D visualization, simulation/plots, staging/clustering, six degrees of freedom, optimization, Java and named exports. No launch-safety or regulatory claims.

072cc86568781283ab19d9c7593fd17024715346.text: OpenSesame is an experiment builder for psychology, neuroscience and experimental economics. Researchers can assemble experiments in a graphical interface and extend them with Python or JavaScript, including browser-based experiments through OSWeb. The desktop program runs on Windows, macOS and Linux and supports connections to research equipment such as eye trackers, button boxes and EEG devices.
072cc86568781283ab19d9c7593fd17024715346.review_note: Official documentation identifies the research tool and establishes GUI, languages, OSWeb, supported desktop platforms and equipment integration. Disambiguated from the workforce-learning company.

ebbe2c1eade172814c32d478695b70656f27f052.text: OpenSpades is an online voxel first-person shooter based on Ace of Spades 0.75. Players take part in matches on destructible terrain using community-created game modes, including Capture the Flag. It runs as a desktop game on Windows, macOS and Linux, with a network connection, keyboard and pointing device listed among its requirements.

sources.title: Play OpenSpades, the open-source voxel first-person shooter

ebbe2c1eade172814c32d478695b70656f27f052.review_note: Creator homepage establishes clone identity, online shooter gameplay, destructible terrain, community modes and desktop requirements. No protocol-compatibility guarantee or tested hardware claim.

0056a935b6e84440f3a725975749b355fdb77739.text: OpenTaxSolver calculates entries for U.S. federal and supported state personal-income-tax forms and fills printable PDF returns for mailing. Users can enter figures through a graphical interface or prepare text input files for command-line processing, then inspect intermediate and final calculations. It is intended for people preparing their own taxes with the relevant government instruction booklets.
0056a935b6e84440f3a725975749b355fdb77739.review_note: Official overview establishes federal/state calculation, PDF auto-fill and mailing, GUI/text workflows, intermediate results and self-preparation with government booklets. No e-filing, all-state coverage, correctness or tax-advice claims.

0a5a5e152bc1c7df4f5d23dfabd26e769f4a966d.text: OpenDex runs inside Roblox through an executor and combines an instance explorer with a Luau script viewer. It supports code navigation, cross-script searches, function flowcharts and call graphs. Runtime inspection exposes live values and traces, while annotations can preserve renamed variables and notes between decompilations. Individual features depend on the functions provided by the executor.
0a5a5e152bc1c7df4f5d23dfabd26e769f4a966d.review_note: Reviewed the cited commit-permalink README and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

0ace731f98a4c69ac44ae115a75f75ea976da862.text: OpenTSDB stores, indexes and serves time-series metrics collected from network equipment, operating systems and applications. It uses HBase as its underlying storage layer and makes recorded measurements accessible for querying and graphing. The system is intended for collecting repeated observations across multiple hosts and applications, with storage distributed through HBase.
0ace731f98a4c69ac44ae115a75f75ea976da862.review_note: Reviewed the cited commit-permalink README and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

0b5c4741d1c147be5fddf0c75c5c0f478ced75a3.text: OpenClaw runs an AI assistant on a user-managed computer and connects it to messaging services such as Slack, Telegram and WhatsApp. A Gateway coordinates sessions, tools and channel connections, with browser, terminal and command-line interfaces for control. Hosted or local model providers can supply inference, while plugins, skills and companion applications extend the available actions.
0b5c4741d1c147be5fddf0c75c5c0f478ced75a3.review_note: Reviewed the cited commit-permalink README and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

0bc9f846c8e1331834dcdd3a3c23c36a8a16c809.text: Opensend provides a self-hosted email application with Amazon SES onboarding and domain setup. Authentication, teams, SSO and OAuth use Convex, and deployment can use a local Convex backend or Convex Cloud. The documented installer uses Docker Compose. Other dashboard functions still rely on demo data while their backend implementations are developed.
0bc9f846c8e1331834dcdd3a3c23c36a8a16c809.review_note: Reviewed the cited commit-permalink README and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

0c24b19daba066234656599b7689bdce6ce04a8c.text: OpenTrainer runs an indoor cycling interface in desktop Chrome or Edge, connecting to FTMS trainers through Web Bluetooth. It supports live ride metrics and ERG interval workouts, with activities, workouts and a training calendar stored locally as JSON. An MCP interface lets compatible AI clients create training plans and review recorded activities. Manual FIT export is also available.
0c24b19daba066234656599b7689bdce6ce04a8c.review_note: Reviewed the cited commit-permalink README and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

06d30a3e4c183c1f877debce4e5de2025034ce68.text: OpenScion provides server-centric source control for large monorepositories used by AI agents and CI jobs. Clients request selected files and directories while the server handles history, diffs, commits and rebasing through an API. The implementation includes a command-line client and web interface, with local filesystem and SQLite storage options for a single-node deployment.
06d30a3e4c183c1f877debce4e5de2025034ce68.review_note: Reviewed the cited official source and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

e2f9ef08304c955ba8342768249b69fa30371435.text: OpenABL adds a graphical boot menu and standard Linux boot methods to Qualcomm Android bootloader firmware for supported handheld chipsets. Users can select Linux or Android and choose internal storage, SD cards or USB drives as boot sources. The menu supports boot entries, recovery options and persistent settings; installation requires firmware flashing for the matching chipset.
e2f9ef08304c955ba8342768249b69fa30371435.review_note: Reviewed the cited official source and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

68c021e20c1d532b053eeea3dd909ae024627c61.text: OpenSequence runs sales outreach sequences through an API, coordinating email follow-ups, SMS, calls and tasks for human operators. It schedules steps, processes replies and opt-outs, and returns events through webhooks. The service is self-hosted with PostgreSQL and container deployment, while REST, TypeScript and MCP interfaces connect it to a separate CRM or application interface.
68c021e20c1d532b053eeea3dd909ae024627c61.review_note: Reviewed the cited official source and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

e30c092e43a54d5e7f675e251625a0bcfb59e18c.text: Open3D supplies C++ and Python data structures and algorithms for processing three-dimensional data. Its capabilities include scene reconstruction, surface alignment, visualization and physically based rendering, with GPU support for core operations. Python packages and C++ builds support local development, while the Open3D-ML extension connects the library to PyTorch and TensorFlow workflows.
e30c092e43a54d5e7f675e251625a0bcfb59e18c.review_note: Reviewed the cited official source and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

658154879f83825b5fa01fa5728089b336e72d75.text: OpenSpiel provides game environments, algorithms and evaluation tools for reinforcement learning, search and planning research. It covers single-agent and multi-agent settings, including cooperative, competitive, turn-based and simultaneous-move games with complete or incomplete information. The core game API is implemented in C++ and exposed to Python, with algorithms and analysis tools available in both languages.
658154879f83825b5fa01fa5728089b336e72d75.review_note: Reviewed the cited official source and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

a61eb4a0cf8007496765bde0c52c2b5c98f6d8e4.text: OpenUSD provides libraries for authoring, reading and streaming time-sampled scene descriptions between graphics applications. Its build supports Linux, macOS and Windows, with optional Python bindings, imaging components and the usdview inspection tool. Additional library-only targets support embedding in iOS and visionOS applications or WebAssembly environments; the available components depend on the selected build configuration.
a61eb4a0cf8007496765bde0c52c2b5c98f6d8e4.review_note: Reviewed the cited official source and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

0c1d0e794277c84119b834c4fff9213b247e62fe.text: OpenWhispr is a desktop application for dictation, meeting transcription and spoken interaction with AI assistants. Hotkeys can insert transcribed speech at the cursor or send a voice command. It also supports notes, imported audio and translation, using local models or configured cloud providers. Desktop releases cover macOS, Windows and Linux, with some features varying by platform.
0c1d0e794277c84119b834c4fff9213b247e62fe.review_note: Reviewed the cited official source and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

2e067b6f772098b4eab863cdd66e4fe15d4f6788.text: OpenReader turns EPUB, PDF, TXT, Markdown and DOCX documents into synchronized read-along audio, with word highlighting and background generation. It can use self-hosted speech servers or cloud text-to-speech providers and export audiobooks as M4B or MP3. Self-hosting options include Docker, configurable database and object storage backends, and a separate compute worker for document processing.
2e067b6f772098b4eab863cdd66e4fe15d4f6788.review_note: Reviewed the cited official source and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

73a5f910365e4bae9875aec5d471bb7fceb3f2fc.text: OpenTaco, formerly Digger, coordinates Terraform workflows using existing CI infrastructure. A command-line component runs infrastructure commands, while an orchestrator triggers jobs from events such as pull-request comments. Features include plan and apply actions, pull-request locks, policy checks and drift detection. The orchestrator can be self-hosted, and jobs execute in the configured CI environment.
73a5f910365e4bae9875aec5d471bb7fceb3f2fc.review_note: Reviewed the cited official source and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

79c63bf03f65fab31691d3f9dd0a884196d15614.text: Open Moderator is a Reddit application that assists subreddit moderation. It can send explanations after removals, flag inconsistencies with previously approved content, monitor comment exchanges and suggest rule changes from removal history. Moderators install it through Reddit’s app listing and configure individual features; AI-powered functions use a supplied Gemini API key, while some checks use word matching.

79c63bf03f65fab31691d3f9dd0a884196d15614.review_note: Reviewed the cited official source and checked each capability and deployment statement. Proposed for maintainer review.

0c5e750b6c4f40cc0308f50945d2af6b2d6d8b5c.text: Open CASCADE Technology supplies C++ libraries for building applications that create, manipulate and display 3D surfaces and solids. Its CAD data-exchange components support moving models between engineering workflows. Developers integrate the libraries into CAD, manufacturing, measurement or simulation software, using source builds or platform-specific binary packages.
0c5e750b6c4f40cc0308f50945d2af6b2d6d8b5c.review_note: Capabilities and deployment wording checked against the cited official documentation. Agent content review; proposed for maintainer review in this draft PR.

0d064ee8884cc3b3956851e001bdb0df09b648e3.text: OpenVAS Scanner executes vulnerability tests from the Greenbone feed as the scanning engine within Greenbone Community Edition and Enterprise appliances. Administrators can build the scanner from source or deploy its container image alongside the other Greenbone components. The repository also contains a Rust implementation that brings scanner services together around the existing scan engine.
0d064ee8884cc3b3956851e001bdb0df09b648e3.review_note: Capabilities and deployment wording checked against the cited official documentation. Agent content review; proposed for maintainer review in this draft PR.

0d4467f306bb25393b8b8247afed58ae0367b1fb.text: openWakeWord detects activation words and phrases in audio streams for voice-controlled applications. Its Python interface accepts microphone, network or file audio and returns detection scores using supplied or custom-trained models. Local inference supports ONNX and, on Linux, TensorFlow Lite. Optional voice-activity detection, noise suppression and speaker-specific verification can refine which activations are accepted.
0d4467f306bb25393b8b8247afed58ae0367b1fb.review_note: Capabilities and deployment wording checked against the cited official documentation. Agent content review; proposed for maintainer review in this draft PR.

0d5ca9e51c318e2cb063417b27f678cd3e3d1aee.text: OpenMyMemo stores AI memory in a local folder of editable Markdown files and shares selected topics with connected MCP applications. A desktop app, browser-based local panel and command-line interface expose memories, imports, exports and change history. Users can review, edit or undo proposed changes and configure connector access and approval requirements.
0d5ca9e51c318e2cb063417b27f678cd3e3d1aee.review_note: Capabilities and deployment wording checked against the cited official documentation. Agent content review; proposed for maintainer review in this draft PR.

0d67a1ccd6b1930005c9295d21493d4c0020a343.text: OpenLDAP provides directory services through its slapd server, storing structured entries that applications can search and update using LDAP. Administrators can organize account, group, address-book or configuration data, define access controls and replicate directories across servers. Database backends and extension modules support different deployments; the suite also includes lloadd for distributing requests among directory servers.

sources.title: OpenLDAP 2.6 Administrator’s Guide: Introduction to OpenLDAP Directory Services

0d67a1ccd6b1930005c9295d21493d4c0020a343.review_note: Capabilities and deployment wording checked against the cited official documentation. Agent content review; proposed for maintainer review in this draft PR.

d2742f542f3a2152f203c9334f100c7f2cd60f12.text: opendeck edits slide decks locally in a desktop window or browser, storing each presentation as an HTML file with its media.
